
<h2 id="syscall-6"><code>Syscall6</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Syscall6(number: uint64, arg0: uint64, arg1: uint64, arg2: uint64, arg3: uint64, arg4: uint64, arg5: uint64) -> int64
```

Executes a raw FreeBSD system call with six arguments.

**Parameters**

| `arg1`   | `uint64` | the call's second argument |
| `arg2`   | `uint64` | the call's third argument  |
| `arg3`   | `uint64` | the call's fourth argument |
| `arg4`   | `uint64` | the call's fifth argument  |
| `arg5`   | `uint64` | the call's sixth argument  |

**Returns**: the kernel's raw result

<h2 id="sign-extend-fd"><code>SignExtendFd</code></h2>

```rux
pub func SignExtendFd(fd: int32) -> uint64
```

Widens a file descriptor to the register width a system call takes it in.
`fd` is read by value; the widened value is returned by copy. Sign extension is what matters: `-1` has to arrive
as all ones rather than as a small positive number.
Cannot fail. Runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Syscall.rux#L281)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type    | Description             |
| ---- | ------- | ----------------------- |
| `fd` | `int32` | the descriptor to widen |

**Returns**: it sign-extended, so a negative one stays negative
